en.name: Severing Thrust
en.description: Prerequisite: Use the [Secret Book] Abyssal Legacy ([The Magnus] Abyssal Revelation quest reward) Strike upwards with your shield to float your opponent then thrust forward to deal a devastating blow with your sword.
